Æth. * Full text (45 Ko) * Red and blue only * Red only

   

MIND. [1] [Æth.]
Idiocy, in some cases alternating with furor.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Æth.]
Herpetic eruption at end of nose.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Æth.]
A drawn condition, beginning at alæ nasi, and extending to angle of mouth, gave face an expression of great anxiety and pain.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Æth.]
Intolerance of milk.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Æth.]
Suitable to children who cannot bear milk.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Æth.]
Violent sudden vomiting ; of a frothy milk-white substance ; of yellow fluid, followed by curdled milk and cheesy matter.
The milk is forcibly ejected soon after taken ; then weakness causes drowsiness. θ Nursing children.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Æth.]
Intolerance of milk ; child by a sudden and violent effort throws it up, curdled or not ; then weakness makes it drowsy for some minutes.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Æth.]
Dozing of child after vomiting spells or after stool.
